name: organic-garden
vibe: A warm cream garden reel — petals and leaves drift down past soft sage light-blobs, double rolling hills breathe along the base, a sprout draws itself out of the soil and stems grow like a living bar chart. Round Caprasimo display over Figtree; headlines BLOOM up from the ground and the key word gets a hand-drawn dashed seed-ring. Calm, alive, unmistakably organic — gardens, plants, wellness, eco brands, farm-to-table and anything that grows.
